notes: Hook wiring for one repo. Merge the 'hooks' block into your existing .claude/settings.json; the rest of that file (permissions, model, env) is untouched by this system. Commands run through a shell, so $HOME and $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR both expand and no absolute path is needed. The interpreter is the venv from INSTALL.md step 1: it must be the venv one, because sqlite-vec and fastembed live there. Sync output is redirected to a log rather than stdout, because SessionStart stdout lands in your context and a sync summary every session is noise. os_lint prints nothing when the corpus is clean, so it stays on stdout on purpose: when it does speak, you want to see it.
